description: The detached inspector windows, one per comparison — labelled `inspector:<session>`, which is how each knows whose console it is showing. One holds no state and speaks to nobody but its own app window, over the two event channels in `detached.utils.ts` — so it needs the event API and nothing else. No updater, no restart, no sidecar: everything it asks for is asked on its behalf by the window that owns the panes.
